name: Repair Windows system files (DISM + SFC)
description: Downloads clean copies of damaged system components with DISM, then verifies every protected file with SFC. Run this first when Windows behaves strangely.
script:
Invoke-RwNative "$env:SystemRoot\System32\Dism.exe" '/Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth' | Out-Null
Invoke-RwNative "$env:SystemRoot\System32\sfc.exe" '/scannow' | Out-Null
'Finished. If SFC repaired files, restart your PC.'

name: Reset Windows Update
description: Stops update services, renames the SoftwareDistribution and catroot2 caches (kept as .bak), re-registers components and restarts the services. Fixes stuck or failing updates.

name: Reset network stack
description: Resets Winsock and TCP/IP, flushes DNS and renews DHCP. Fixes "connected, no internet" after VPN or tweak mishaps.
script:
Invoke-RwNative "$env:SystemRoot\System32\netsh.exe" 'winsock reset' | Out-Null
Invoke-RwNative "$env:SystemRoot\System32\netsh.exe" 'int ip reset' | Out-Null
Invoke-RwNative "$env:SystemRoot\System32\ipconfig.exe" '/flushdns' | Out-Null
'Network stack reset. Restart your PC to finish.'

name: Flush DNS cache
description: Clears cached DNS lookups. Fixes websites that moved or will not load.
script: Clear-DnsClientCache; "DNS cache cleared"

name: Set DNS: Cloudflare (1.1.1.1)
description: Fast, privacy-focused DNS on all connected adapters.

name: Set DNS: Quad9 (malware blocking)
description: DNS that blocks known malicious domains.

name: Set DNS: Google (8.8.8.8)
description: Google Public DNS.

name: Set DNS: AdGuard (ad blocking)
description: DNS that blocks ads and trackers network-wide.

name: Set DNS: automatic (router / ISP)
description: Removes custom DNS and goes back to DHCP-provided servers.
script:
foreach ($a in (Get-NetAdapter -Physical -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object Status -eq 'Up')) { Set-DnsClientServerAddress -InterfaceIndex $a.ifIndex -ResetServerAddresses; "$($a.Name): DNS automatic" }
Clear-DnsClientCache

name: Delete temporary files
description: Deletes files older than 1 day from your Temp folder and the Windows Temp folder. Files in use are skipped.

name: Deep disk cleanup
description: Runs Disk Cleanup with every safe category (update leftovers, delivery optimization cache, thumbnails, error reports...) plus component store cleanup.
script:
$vc = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\VolumeCaches'
$skip = 'DownloadsFolder','Recycle Bin'
Get-ChildItem $vc | Where-Object { $skip -notcontains $_.PSChildName } | ForEach-Object { Set-ItemProperty $_.PSPath -Name StateFlags4242 -Value 2 -Type DWord -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
Start-Process "$env:SystemRoot\System32\cleanmgr.exe" '/sagerun:4242' -Wait
Invoke-RwNative "$env:SystemRoot\System32\Dism.exe" '/Online /Cleanup-Image /StartComponentCleanup' | Out-Null
'Disk cleanup finished (Downloads and Recycle Bin were not touched).'

name: Repair winget
description: Reinstalls App Installer (winget) and resets its sources. Fixes "winget not recognized" and source errors.
script:
Install-RwWinget
$wg = Get-RwWinget
if ($wg) { Invoke-RwNative $wg 'source reset --force --disable-interactivity' | Out-Null; Invoke-RwNative $wg 'source update --disable-interactivity' | Out-Null }
'winget repaired'

name: Reset Microsoft Edge WebView2 runtime
description: Runs the Evergreen WebView2 installer in repair mode (or reinstalls the runtime through winget if the installer is missing). Fixes apps that show a blank window or crash on start. Rigwright Desktop uses WebView2 itself, so its window may go blank - just reopen the app afterwards.

name: Microsoft Defender: quick scan
description: Updates signatures and runs a quick malware scan.
script: Update-MpSignature -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-MpScan -ScanType QuickScan; $t = Get-MpThreatDetection; if ($t) { "Threats found: $(@($t).Count) - see Windows Security" } else { "No threats found" }

name: Microsoft Defender: full scan
description: Updates signatures and scans every file. Can take an hour or more.
script: Update-MpSignature -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-MpScan -ScanType FullScan; $t = Get-MpThreatDetection; if ($t) { "Threats found: $(@($t).Count) - see Windows Security" } else { "No threats found" }

name: Microsoft Defender: offline boot scan
description: Restarts the PC into a Defender offline scan to remove rootkits. Your PC WILL restart about a minute after this starts.
script: Start-MpWDOScan; "Offline scan scheduled - the PC restarts shortly"

name: Fix clock: sync time with pool.ntp.org
description: Points Windows Time at the public NTP pool and forces a resync. Fixes certificate errors caused by a wrong clock.
script:
Set-Service w32time -StartupType Automatic; Start-Service w32time -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Invoke-RwNative "$env:SystemRoot\System32\w32tm.exe" '/config /manualpeerlist:"pool.ntp.org time.windows.com" /syncfromflags:manual /reliable:yes /update' | Out-Null
Invoke-RwNative "$env:SystemRoot\System32\w32tm.exe" '/resync /force' | Out-Null
"Time now: $(Get-Date)"

name: Rebuild icon and thumbnail cache
description: Fixes blank or wrong icons and thumbnails. Explorer restarts.
script:
Get-Process explorer -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force
Remove-Item "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\IconCache.db" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-Item "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer\iconcache_*.db","$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer\thumbcache_*.db" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Start-Sleep 1; if (-not (Get-Process explorer -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Start-Process explorer.exe }
'Icon cache rebuilt'

name: Reset Microsoft Store cache
description: Clears the Store cache (wsreset). Fixes Store downloads that will not start.
script: Start-Process "$env:SystemRoot\System32\wsreset.exe" -Wait; "Store cache reset"

name: Re-register built-in apps
description: Re-registers every installed Store/system app for all users. Fixes Start menu, Settings or Calculator not opening.

name: Fix stuck print queue
description: Stops the print spooler, clears stuck jobs and restarts it.
script:
Stop-Service Spooler -Force
Remove-Item "$env:SystemRoot\System32\spool\PRINTERS\*" -Force -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Start-Service Spooler
'Print queue cleared'

name: Restart audio services
description: Restarts Windows Audio. Fixes sudden loss of sound without a reboot.
script: Restart-Service AudioEndpointBuilder -Force; Start-Service Audiosrv; "Audio restarted"

name: Check system drive for errors (online scan)
description: Runs a read-only online scan of the system drive. Reports problems without locking the disk.
script: Invoke-RwNative "$env:SystemRoot\System32\chkdsk.exe" "$env:SystemDrive /scan" | Out-Null

name: Repair WMI repository
description: Verifies and salvages the WMI repository. Fixes tools that cannot read system information.
script:
Invoke-RwNative "$env:SystemRoot\System32\wbem\winmgmt.exe" '/verifyrepository' | Out-Null
Invoke-RwNative "$env:SystemRoot\System32\wbem\winmgmt.exe" '/salvagerepository' | Out-Null

name: Turn on System Restore (5% of C:)
description: Enables System Restore on the system drive and reserves 5% of space for restore points. Strongly recommended before tweaking.
script:
Enable-ComputerRestore -Drive "$env:SystemDrive\"
Invoke-RwNative "$env:SystemRoot\System32\vssadmin.exe" "resize shadowstorage /for=$env:SystemDrive /on=$env:SystemDrive /maxsize=5%" | Out-Null
'System Restore enabled'

name: Back up all drivers to the Desktop
description: Exports every third-party driver to Desktop\DriverBackup - handy before a reinstall.
script:
$d = Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath('Desktop')) ('DriverBackup-' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd'))
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $d | Out-Null
$r = Export-WindowsDriver -Online -Destination $d
"Exported $(@($r).Count) drivers to $d"

name: Battery health report
description: Creates a detailed battery report (design vs. current capacity) on your Desktop.
script:
$f = Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath('Desktop')) 'battery-report.html'
Invoke-RwNative "$env:SystemRoot\System32\powercfg.exe" "/batteryreport /output `"$f`"" | Out-Null
"Saved $f"

name: Wi-Fi diagnostics report
description: Generates the built-in WLAN report (disconnects, errors) and saves its location.
script: Invoke-RwNative "$env:SystemRoot\System32\netsh.exe" "wlan show wlanreport" | Out-Null; "Report: C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows\WlanReport\wlan-report-latest.html"

name: Check for Windows updates now
description: Opens Windows Update and starts a scan.
script: Start-Process "ms-settings:windowsupdate-action"; "Windows Update opened"
